{{Quote|We'll never get out of here alive. Do me a favor...don't share this with anyone here. Morale is already really low.|[[TR-522]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Deliver Radio|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
'''Camp Delta''' was one of five refugee camps established within the [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] following an [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|outbreak]] of the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|I need you to pull some guard duty outside the walls to keep the enemy from waltzing in our front door.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Erlem Marh]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FWDC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Forward Watch, Delta Camp|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> an accident happened in an [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] where the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was secretly conducting dangerous scientific research to engineer the dreadful [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] into a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]]. The virus [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|escaped]] containment and turned most of the people ins the area flesh-craving [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] creatures. The Empire promptly established a [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] to contain the infection.<ref name="SWG:MMR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Mysterious Meeting Request|Dathomir}}</ref> The few people who survived the virus outbreak, mostly Imperial staff and prisoners, were trapped in the Quarantine Zone. They established five camps inside the area, [[Camp Alpha]], [[Camp Beta]], [[Camp Gamma]], Camp Delta and [[Camp Epsilon]], in order to try to live in safety while waiting for an evacuation,<ref name="SWG:CLC" /> albeit all rescue teams were attacked upon landing in the area and their members were killed before they could find the survivors.<ref name="SWG:MMR" /> The camps were named by the [[TIE pilot]] [[Jeb Maris]] who had managed to deliver radios from Camp Alpha to the other camp and had established communication between them.<ref name="SWG:DR" />

Contrary to the other camps that were hastily established with concrete slabs, disabled devices and other waste materials, Camp Delta was heavily fortified and possessed its own defensive wall. In fact, the camp was originally a forward post part of the defensive system of the Imperial Research and Prison Facility before the epidemic. Nevertheless, all the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] stationed there, but [[TR-522]], were infected and died during the outbreak.<ref name="SWG:TR522">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=conversation|[[TR-522]]|Dathomir}}</ref> Camp Delta was then inhabited by a ragtag group of survivors made of Imperial troopers, ex-prisoners and soldiers of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]],<ref name="SWG:CLC" /> and the defense was led by Imperial [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Erlem Marh]]. Indeed, the camp came under regular attack from the zombies and the refugees had to struggle for their survival.<ref name="SWG:FWDC" /> Other survivors included stormtrooper TR-522<ref name="SWG:DR" /> and the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Oona Wran]].<ref name="SWG:QZVCD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Quarantine Zone Virus Container Demolition}}</ref>

Several spacers later visited Camp Delta during their journey in the Quarantine Zone and assisted the survivors in their fight against the undeads.<ref name="SWG:FWDC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Camp Delta was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CLC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Camp Delta was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," a.k.a. the [[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|"Death Troopers" update]], released on [[October 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
